research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Axiamatic is engaged in research and development focused on AI-driven solutions for ERP transformation, as reflected in the work titled 'Message proxying among messaging systems.' This involves receiving messages from users of one system, associating them with threads, translating messages based on user personas, and transmitting the translated content, indicating efforts to enhance communication and integration across enterprise platforms.

press_references.value: Axiamatic Launches With $54M from Greylock and Bessemer to End the Era of Failed Enterprise Transformations

product_launches.description: Axiamatic publicly launched its agentic enterprise transformation platform, which builds a digital twin of programs and uses AI agents to monitor risks and support stakeholders with persona-specific assistants.

overview_description.description: Axiamatic is the agentic platform built to accelerate and assure enterprise transformations. Large-scale programs, ERP modernizations, CRM rollouts, post-merger integrations, and source-to-pay migrations, involve hundreds of evolving requirements, decisions spread across dozens of teams, and organizational resistance that rarely surfaces in status reports. Axiamatic continuously ingests signals from 250+ enterprise systems, builds a living knowledge graph of how the program is actually running, and deploys specialized AI agents to detect execution risk, requirements drift, and adoption gaps before they compound into overruns. The platform surfaces role-specific insights and recommended actions for CIOs, CFOs, PMOs, and change leaders, shifting programs from reactive firefighting to proactive assurance. Axiamatic is trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises including Heico, Marmon, Adobe, and Corning, and is backed by Greylock Partners and Bessemer Venture Partners. The company was founded by Rajiv Gupta and Kaushik Narayan, who previously co-founded Skyhigh Networks (acquired by McAfee).

about_short_description.short_description: Agentic Control Plane for Enterprise Transformation

product.name: Axiamatic Platform
product.description: An AI-native control plane for enterprise transformation programs that consolidates program context, detects emerging risks, and provides role-specific guidance to improve execution.

product.name: Free Risk Assessment
product.description: A diagnostic service that evaluates an enterprise transformation program for interdependencies, execution drift, and readiness gaps.

product.name: Phase 0 Review
product.description: A transformation-readiness review that uses existing program artifacts to establish context and identify lessons, dependencies, and early execution risks.

product.name: Axiamatic Partner Program
product.description: A partnership offering for system integrators, consultancies, technology vendors, and resellers to embed Axiamatic’s transformation intelligence into delivery services.
